distribution.name: imdb_top_1000.csv
distribution.description:
This file contains information about the top 1000 IMDb movies.

Each row represents a single movie and includes:

- Poster link for movie thumbnail
- Movie title
- Release year
- Certification (age rating)
- Runtime in minutes
- Movie genres
- IMDb rating
- Plot overview
- Metacritic score
- Director name
- Four main actors
- Number of IMDb votes
- Gross revenue

The dataset is fully cleaned and structured for easy analysis.

name: IMDb Top 1000 Movies Dataset (Ratings, Cast, Genre
description:
This dataset contains detailed information about the top 1000 movies listed on IMDb.

It includes movie metadata such as title, release year, certification, runtime, genre, IMDb rating, meta score, director, main cast, number of votes, gross revenue, and a short plot overview.

Key Features:
- 1000 movies with rich metadata
- Ratings from IMDb and Metacritic
- Genre and runtime information
- Cast and director details
- Revenue and popularity indicators

This dataset is suitable for:
- Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
- Movie recommendation systems
- Trend analysis over years
- Rating prediction models
- Genre-based analysis
- Data visualization projects

The dataset is clean, structured, and ready for analysis.
